extraction: All 20 original stdout/stderr streams from 10 real commands were decoded losslessly, checked against declared byte lengths/SHA256 and final command receipts, then frozen before independent TAP inventory analysis. SHA256 input is normalized with Array.from for Uint8Array compatibility.

tapChecks.label: template-subscriptions-unit
caseNames: the production gate logs in as SMOKE without pinning an owner workspace or bot
a different application commit is refused before login, enrollment or candidate creation
a release receipt names the actual candidate, revision, model and registered device
startup correlation survives claude_code failure before a run exists
startup correlation survives codex failure before a run exists
startup correlation requires exact candidate binding and existing metadata
startup correlation rejects malformed identifiers and preserves independently valid fields
startup correlation keeps only closed refusal codes and never emits prompts or other identities
successful candidate diagnostics do not gain startup correlation metadata
a pre-dispatch refusal keeps its phase without reading an unpublished proof and cleans both candidates
dispatch refusal diagnostics admit only fixed business codes and never untrusted details
a failed subscription still tests the other candidate and closes every created instance and device
candidate acceptance is pinned to the outer SMOKE/team payer and always closes its normal session
a real receipt rejection persists its run hash and reason without provider text or credentials
preflight failures preserve their phase and closed error details without producing an accepted file
a failure before a sample exists preserves the startup phase without inventing sample evidence
startup failure projection drops unknown content and only admits numeric HTTP error statuses
failure diagnostics retain only fixed cleanup outcomes and unknown exceptions become a generic code
retained cleanup identities must belong to this case and contain at most four distinct UUIDs
a terminal-before-proof failure identifies only its owned case and the missing evidence
cleanup failures retain bounded step families and HTTP status without arbitrary causes
a failed pair preserves the genuine passing receipt without creating publishable evidence
failure projection bounds cleanup rows and refuses foreign or malformed fixture identities
the observed Codex adapter-start failure retains false agent_start and error cli_init
failed execution retains only bound registration binary metadata without a passing receipt
registration diagnostics reject unbounded or non-original binary metadata without leaking it
bootstrap adoption is required; ordinary FD3, wrong run, duplicate warmup or descriptor auth cannot publish
bootstrap projection, repeated publication and VM proof failures still reclaim both candidate devices and VMs
bootstrap failure diagnostics preserve existing strict timings and final binding checks without accepting the pair
bootstrap failure timing projection rejects foreign, oversized and private values without widening adoption
bootstrap failure binding checks name the rejected predicate without exporting bootstrap or hint values
successful candidate gate adds no failure diagnostics and keeps the original accepted receipt
failure projection distinguishes the closed 3c production shapes using synthetic identities

tapChecks.label: native-read-batch-unit
caseNames: concurrent owner-wide readers reuse their actual personal home only within the batch
different Live kinds share one revision query before either consumer reads its data
owner observations are separate for parallel batches, owners and database authorities
later reads in one batch keep the earlier revision, while the next batch reads the new revision
a missing or failed revision never becomes fabricated proof and does not poison the next request
ordinary revision readers and different database scopes remain independent
bound after-work cannot reuse an already completed batch authority observation
notification target resolution never inherits an earlier list-read home, even inside the batch
planned owner readers share one earlier observation without exposing each other's keys
an undeclared batch keeps ordinary per-reader observations
a selected team key stays late and total requested and returned keys stay unchanged
owner homes and database authorities do not borrow another planned observation
absent homes and invalid or nonrevision refs never trigger an owner prefetch
an entity or another owner key does not start the resolved home's list prefetch
missing and failed prefetched revisions remain unknown until another request reads
throw and cancellation release the plan as well as its earlier observations
authorized workspace readers share their earlier Team revisions despite different readiness
authorized Team plans do not resolve a Personal home or borrow a different workspace
entities, unresolved scopes and mismatched workspace refs never start a Team plan
workspace revision observations use the actual executor behind one request proxy
workspace plans never supply foreground revisions to after, cron or workflow reads
workspace plan failure and completed lifetimes never fabricate or retain revision proof
authorized Team list prefetch reduces three separately ready fixed-revision reads to one SQL
pending workspace choices share one fresh SELECT and independent scalar rows before dispatch
a workspace SELECT is removed before callback construction and Drizzle thenable assimilation
a later workspace read cannot join an in-flight or completed pre-revocation SELECT
workspace queue failures reject only their joined readers and never poison a later read
workspace choices are partitioned by request, SQL family, executor, session, reader, pin and principal
transactions, absent Native identity, unknown principal and detached work bypass the workspace queue
parallel and successive Native batches never share a workspace observation

tapChecks.label: action-read-egress
caseNames: task run rows keep the newest owner run and the 200-row limit without unused fields
one bounded snapshot aggregate preserves the old fingerprint and exact expiry, including empty rows
task thread lists retain exact titles, summaries and privacy while details retain full errors
team link reads page through all authorized pairs and retain explicit-id scope checks
identity projections are bounded and every read has a fixed action source
both actions preserve owner, peer, missing and null-issue boundaries
the changes result still returns valid checkpoints and rejects unreadable gzip
the newest checkpoint follows only the same owner and workspace chain
a cyclic chain fails before returning checkpoint content
suspension and removal are read afresh, including Bot threads without an issue
thread identity reads keep owner-only, live membership and checkpoint behavior with bounded fields
the existing no-links option keeps the exact real predicate and avoids two pages of unused links
the real task-run action reads no team metadata and still reads current tenant membership
token pinning and foreign-workspace denial remain on the original action path
suspension and removal are fresh on every call even with trusted principal provenance
task-run visibility skips unused team metadata without weakening fresh workspace authority
five concurrent authenticated readers issue one unchanged membership-and-link SELECT
completed reads never hide same-batch suspension, removal or restoration
a membership change is visible while the earlier real SELECT is still unresolved
a newly attached archived Organization is visible before the old SELECT resolves
joined readers still execute independent current Organization policy checks
different authenticated readers, pins, principals, requests and Native sessions cannot join
top-level Workspace transactions and nested savepoints bypass the pending queue
foreground-only scope cannot survive as deferred, expired or non-Native work
Native workspace choices share only undispatched real SELECTs and retain fresh authority
